headline: Moderna Prepares Phase 3 Trial Data Release for Custom Cancer Vaccine
summary: Moderna will release full Phase 3 trial data this weekend for its customized cancer treatment, a key experimental therapy that has driven its share performance this year.
why: Moderna is a U.S. biotechnology company whose pipeline success in individualized mRNA oncology treatments is critical to replacing declining post-pandemic vaccine revenues.

impacts.name: Moderna
impacts.why: Trial data outcomes will directly determine the commercial path and regulatory review for its flagship oncology program.
